PreInvocation.command: python3 -c 'import json, subprocess; required={"filipkrawiec-core", "filipkrawiec-workflow", "filipkrawiec-authoring"}; installed={plugin.get("name") for plugin in json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["agy", "plugin", "list"], text=True)).get("imports", [])}; missing=sorted(required-installed); print(json.dumps({"injectSteps":[{"ephemeralMessage":"SDLC blocked: required companion plugins are unavailable to Antigravity: " + ", ".join(missing)}]} if missing else {}))'

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, subprocess; required={"filipkrawiec-core", "filipkrawiec-workflow", "filipkrawiec-authoring"}; installed={plugin.get("name") for plugin in json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["agy", "plugin", "list"], text=True)).get("imports", [])}; missing=sorted(required-installed); print(json.dumps({"decision":"deny", "reason":"SDLC blocked: required companion plugins are unavailable to Antigravity: " + ", ".join(missing)} if missing else {"decision":"allow"}))'
